content: MCPB: zip bundle with required manifest.json (manifest_version 0.3, updated 2025-12-02), server/index.js entry, bundled node_modules (npm install --production), optional icon/assets. CLI @anthropic-ai/mcpb (latest 2.1.2, dev-only global/devDependency): mcpb init/validate/pack/sign. mcp_config uses ${__dirname} substitution; user_config sensitive:true masks input + stores securely (OS keychain in Claude Desktop). Node recommended over Python (Claude Desktop ships Node).
